neighbours.label: an adjective for a rewarding experience after 'more': 'more enjoyable', 'more fulfilling'; 'more expensive' stays quiet
fire: Better shoes make long walks a far more enjoyable experience.
Volunteering made her retirement much more fulfilling.
A good guide makes the trip more rewarding for everyone.
Music can make the morning commute more enjoyable.
He found teaching more fulfilling than his old office job.
Small classes make learning more satisfying for pupils.
Friends make every long hike more enjoyable.
Working with her hands was more rewarding than she expected.
quiet: Better shoes make long walks a far more expensive hobby.
Volunteering made her schedule much more crowded.
A good guide makes the trip more costly for everyone.
Roadworks can make the morning commute longer.
He found teaching harder than his old office job.
Small classes make the school more expensive for parents.
Rain makes every long hike slower.
Working with her hands was more tiring than she expected.
